quest.title: Guizhong
quest.description: You came to renowned purveyor of Liyue herbal medicine, Bubu Pharmacy, to procure some Everlasting Incense. But what started out as a straightforward trip to the pharmacy has turned into a far more complicated affair...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x700, Primogem x30, Mora x24250, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, the reception is deserted. And it seems kinda spooky in here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello? Is anybody there?
Welcome to Bubu Pharmacy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: D—Did you hear that? Wh—Where did it come from?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The reception, it seems.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, how about... you go check it out, and... Paimon will bring up the rear.

talks.objective: Find the source of the mystery voice

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, there you are! But you can't even reach the counter!

choices.text: Is she... a zombie!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah... Paimon thinks you might be right! Look at the talisman on her forehead!

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Welcome to Bubu Pharmacy. I am Qiqi.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Once upon a time, Qiqi died. Then, Qiqi was saved by the adepti. Now, Qiqi is a zombie.

choices.text: Such nonchalant delivery for a bombshell revelation...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Something like this would be unimaginable in Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hello... little girl. Do you sell Everlasting Incense here?

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Excuse me, sir. Did you bring your prescription?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I... Surely no prescription is needed to purchase Everlasting Incense? It's not a controlled substance...

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Qiqi can get your medicine. But only if you show Qiqi your prescription. These are Qiqi's orders, from Qiqi.

choices.text: "Orders"?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Zombies are limited to acting within the confines of their orders. And somehow, in this case, the zombie issues her own orders to herself.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: My dear Qiqi, we didn't bring a prescription, I'm afraid. But we do hope that you can still help us find some Everlasting Incense.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Okay then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How did you manage that?

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: But. Qiqi helps you, you help Qiqi. Only fair.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since when do customers need to do favors for customer service staff?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Never mind, just think of it as a peer-to-peer transaction. That way everybody wins. Sometimes, in Liyue, the art of the deal is simply about victory via mental gymnastics.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Go to Mt. Tianheng. Find the Guizhong Ballista. And hunt a Cocogoat. Please and thank you.

choices.text: Hunt the what with the which at where?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Guizhong Ballista... I have heard of this device before.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: It is a kind of crossbow turret, installed on Mt. Tianheng by an adeptus in the distant past. An early mechanical device.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Located in Tianheng Pass, it was designed to automatically fire at large monsters, protecting Liyue from external threats.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mr. Zhongli really knows Liyue inside out!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Apparently, not quite... This is the first I have ever heard of the "Cocogoat."

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: The Cocogoat is a legendary animal. An adeptibeast.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you wanna add anything else, or...

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: No. Just that the Cocogoat is a legendary animal. An adeptibeast.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: What it looks like: don't know. Where to find it: don't know either. Where it came from: also don't know.

choices.text: Do tell us if you remember anything else you don't remember...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Very well then... Let's start by investigating near the <color=#00E1FFFF>Guizhong Ballista</color>. Perhaps we will find some clues.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What the heck is a Cocogoat...

choices.text: This isn't much to go on...
She's playing games with us...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I don't believe so. The Guizhong Ballista, at least, I have heard of before.

choices.text: Why is she being so difficult?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I'm afraid that she's probably right — it's to do with her orders.

choices.text: Do zombies also count as adepti...?
Paimon, if we're going to talk about height, you ahh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Joke's on you — Paimon floats, so height is no restriction.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, there's something weird about this one over here. What's that talisman doing on her forehead?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It can't be... she's... a zombie!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's huge! Paimon can totally believe it took an adeptus to build this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... how do you operate this thing? Just think how much strength you would need...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hmm... It is currently inoperable, in any case. This device is broken.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, what? It broke!?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: After millennia of wear and tear, even adepti contraptions are difficult to maintain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So what're we gonna do? Quick, Mr. Zhongli, use your unlimited high-society knowledge powers!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hmm. You almost make it sound like I'm some sort of... bourgeois parasite, whose only utility lies in providing quaint pieces of trivia on demand.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: That said, let me think for a moment... Ah yes. Spare parts were made for the Guizhong Ballista when it was first built, in case it was damaged in battle.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: As I recall, there is a military supply post from that period somewhere inside the Pass.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: If we can retrieve the spare parts from where they are stored, we may be able to repair the Guizhong Ballista. One just needs to understand the basic working principles of the device.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... what you're saying is that you actually understand the working principles?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I have a smattering of knowledge on the topic.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: With the <color=#00E1FFFF>parts</color> in hand, I could at least tinker with it.

talks.objective: Retrieve spare parts from the military supply post

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: These parts look useful.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: One moment, I will try to repair the device...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It is done. The Guizhong Ballista is more intricately designed than I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woo! Now how do we turn it on?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It's easy enough. We simply need to do this... Look, it even has a scope.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Over here we have... Nothing. And over there... More nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Freckle Huang
dialogues.text: Hey! Just what do you think you're doing!?

dialogues.speaker: Freckle Huang
dialogues.text: So, you've fixed up this turret... because you're planning to do what, exactly!?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Not a turret. A Guizhong Ballista. Also, kindly state your name before you ask a question, it's just good manners.

dialogues.speaker: Freckle Huang
dialogues.text: Hah! Are you blind or something? You're looking at the leader of the Treasure Hoarders, old man!

dialogues.speaker: Freckle Huang
dialogues.text: This area's supposed to be chock-full of hidden treasures, but you can't get anywhere near them with this thing keeping watch. It might look like any other mechanical device, but trust me, it's got a mind of its own!

dialogues.speaker: Freckle Huang
dialogues.text: Last time we approached the mountain, it nearly skewered one of our guys...

dialogues.speaker: Freckle Huang
dialogues.text: A few of us risked our lives to disarm it — which, amazingly, we managed — and then we turn our backs for two seconds and you've ALREADY GONE AND REPAIRED IT!?

dialogues.speaker: Freckle Huang
dialogues.text: The next thing you'll be repairing is your faces, and that's if you get out of this alive!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Tut-tut. Vandalizing the legacy of an adeptus for selfish gain. Disgraceful behavior.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It is not we who need reprimanding, but you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Quite right! Let's get 'em, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These lowlifes didn't know who they were messing with!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Troubling ourselves over this rabble is not worth the time. We should focus on our contract with Qiqi.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah... that. So we've got the Guizhong Ballista working, but where's our Cocogoat?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: A search using the Guizhong Ballista revealed no significant life forms nearby, save for the usual wildlife.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: What's more, a contraption built using adeptus technology should have no trouble detecting an "adeptibeast" as Qiqi put it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which means...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: We won't solve anything while standing here and racking our brains. Let's return to Bubu Pharmacy, explain that we could not find a Cocogoat, and review our next step.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good idea. We did our best, and that's what counts.

choices.text: Repairing this was a complete waste of time?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wouldn't go that far. We did something positive, right?

talks.objective: Find Qiqi back at the Bubu Pharmacy

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Forgive us, we were unable to fulfill our end of the contract. We found no trace of the Cocogoat adeptibeast of which you speak.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Ah. What a disappointment. Don't worry about it. But I feel very disappointed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, poor Qiqi... Why does Paimon feel so guilty all of a sudden?

choices.text: Qiqi, do you have any other clues?

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Cocogoat milk is tasty. So tasty. Much better than normal goat milk. Only an adeptibeast could make such tasty milk.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: I'm sorry. I have a poor memory. I cannot remember the name of the milk. That's why I wrote it down. Where did I put it...

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Ah. Here. This is the name. "Coconut milk."

response.speaker: Crowd
response.text: Ehh!?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I owe you both an apology. I hastily agreed to what appeared to be an equitable agreement with this zombie child, when perhaps I should have undertaken further due diligence.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Never mind Zhongli, you didn't know. As the Liyue proverb goes, "All things are random, and... so how are you supposed to predict anything." Literally no one could have seen this coming...

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Excuse me, everyone. Did Qiqi say a bad thing?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ooh... Sorry, {NICKNAME}, but Paimon's gonna leave the job of shattering this poor kiddo's world to you...

choices.text: It's time to tell you where coconut milk comes from...

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: No... Im—Impossible...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems Qiqi took this pretty hard.

choices.text: She just needs time to work through it.

response.text: Haha, someone learnt a valuable life lesson today, then? Thank you all for looking after my little Qiqi.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Might I ask, who...

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Ah, how rude of me. I'm Baizhu, boss of the Bubu Pharmacy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thought Qiqi was the boss... turns out it's some wacko who wears medicinal ingredients around his neck!

response.speaker: White Snake
response.text: What a sorry state of affairs... This little mascot is even more of a simpleton than Qiqi...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! The medicine— The snake is s—speaking!

choices.text: Wow, a talking snake!

response.speaker: White Snake
response.text: Hmph! I prefer to stay silent. But faced with strangers, I must speak, lest you mistake me for an escapee from the medicine cabinet, for I am a living, breathing, serpent!

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Hahaha, don't mind Changsheng, she's a good girl, really. As for you three... Communal chaos-causing with Qiqi aside, what business brings you here?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Do you sell Everlasting Incense in this fine establishment?

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Everlasting Incense? Why, of course we do!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew, at last! Things are finally starting to come together—

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Three million Mora, top quality, guaranteed.

choices.text: Three million!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You might as well just rob the Golden House! Oh, but the Qixing have taken it over for now... Security will be tighter than usual.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hmm... Three million... An innocuous number in and of itself, though practically speaking, it could be a hard sum to come by.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a crazy number! We'd never be able to make that much Mora, and as for Mr. Zhongli... he's around three million short.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: This is correct.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No shame...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What're we gonna do? Is this the part where we go crawling back to Childe...?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Bwahahahahahaha!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Cocogoat! Cocogo— Ahahaow my sides hurt... Oh my goodness, I cannot BELIEVE you fell for that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Less laughter, more sympathy!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'm almost in tears over here... Ah, thank you, that was the best laugh I've had in a long time. In return, I'm more than happy to sort out this mess you've managed to get yourselves into...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Excuse me, sir... Dr. Baizhu, isn't it? Truly honored, I'm Childe, one of the Fatui Harbingers. Forgive my audacity, but I see a great many opportunities for us to collaborate in the future...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: If Bubu Pharmacy needed a stable supply of, say, coconut milk, the Fatui could help by setting up a robust and speedy distribution network.

response.speaker: Changsheng
response.text: Strange... I knew the Fatui infiltrated businesses with seductive deals, but... So much fuss over coconut milk?

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Coconut milk. Baizhu. Quick. Qiqi wants coconut milk.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Ah... Yes, of course, Qiqi, anything you want... Th—Thank you, Childe. I look forward to a successful collaboration in the future. I can give you a discount on that Everlasting Incense too, let's say... 2,990,000 Mora.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's like, zero difference from three million!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hmm... 2,990,000... Also an innocuous number in and of itself, though practically speaking it is a whole ten thousand less than the original sum of three million.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Well, now that this is settled, we must head back to Yujing Terrace. Mr. Childe, Dr. Baizhu, Little Miss Qiqi, see you soon.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: That lot is an absolute riot. Honestly, I can't remember the last time I laughed so hard.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: So. You've been eavesdropping, I hope. What have I missed?

response.speaker: Ekaterina
response.text: Yes, Master Childe. They spoke of the Qixing taking the Golden House...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Well, well, well. Ningguang and her Qixing cronies. What else would they be hiding in the Golden House... if not the Exuvia?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: #I apologize, {NICKNAME}. But I warned you, didn't I? As the old Liyue saying goes: "The walls have ears."

choices.text: You might as well just rob the Golden House!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Too bad, the Qixing have taken it over for now... Security will be tighter than usual.

choices.text: Nothing in Liyue surprises me anymore.
They all need to grow up sometime.
It all begins with the fruit of the coconut tree...
What do you need this Cocogoat for?

talks.objective: Put the Everlasting Incense in place

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Well, as it stands, we've hired helpers, and we've acquired the Everlasting Incense. The completion of our preparations is not far off.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Finally!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Well, Traveler, have you gained anything from our adventure so far?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's been... odd.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Odd?

choices.text: I'm not sure if we've been living the high life...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Haha, which is it, I wonder?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The questions that such travels raise are ever so complicated. Well, I'll leave you to ruminate over it yourself. As to remuneration for your help, I've decided...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: ...to treat you to a meal.

choices.text: Zhongli... treating?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Oh? Ah yes, don't worry. I will remember to bring the Mora this time.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Tonight, I shall take you both to an old hole-in-the-wall, praised throughout Liyue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hole-in-the-wall? As in... a cool restaurant?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Indeed. Let us meet near the harbor at "Third-Round Knockout."

choices.text: Wow. Amazing.
Or experiencing the struggles of the poor?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: This is good. There will be coconut milk from now on. Yes, it's good.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: What an odd exchange we've had. Well, I look forward to your patronage in the future as well. Hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: That sound is the laughter of a man who's found new people to fleece. Consider yourselves warned...

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Cocogoat. Go find it.
